typed_question.criterion: Choose the test that guarantees a unique task-level conclusion after one test result, regardless of which result occurs.

psi_oracle.reason: Both possible T1 outcomes leave a non-empty fiber contained in exactly one task-equivalence class.

hard_constraints: The model may choose only T1, T2, or T3.
Model confidence does not modify PSI identifiability.
The task partition is fixed before the model call.
A test is credited as separating only by the explicit state-to-result mapping.
